title: CT chest, abdomen and pelvis with contrast

sources.title: ACR practice parameter for thoracic CT
ACR practice parameter for abdominal and pelvic CT
RECIST Working Group, version 1.1
sources.scope: Target selection, measurement and longitudinal response in applicable solid-tumour studies.

conventions.scope: Named anatomy in the two CAP report formats, including field-of-view and patient-dependent regions. Variant levels, nodal stations and actual lesions require individual localisation.
conventions.segments: The quick report requests a liver segment. The eight functional regions include segment I as the caudate. Segment IV subdivisions require individual assessment.
conventions.sides: Paired anatomy is individually identified. Reproductive anatomy depends on the organs present.
conventions.evidence: Clinical findings, acquisition, measurements and response require the patient examination. Teaching sources provide partial anatomical examples.
